name: actuent
description: Search the web as structured data. Get any website's pages and actions as clean JSON instead of raw HTML.
long_description:
Actuent is a search engine built for AI agents. Claude searches Actuent and gets back LAWP: a structured version of each website with its pages summarised in plain English and the actions a visitor can take, such as booking, ordering or contacting.

Free, no account needed: search any topic or domain (with products and prices), find places nearby with opening hours, plan an outing or a city trip, find a service or dish with its price, events, news, trending sites, and ready checkout links for shops.

With an optional Actuent Pro API key (from actuent.ai): perform actions on sites that support it (with confirmation first), price-drop and back-in-stock alerts, connected site accounts and search history.

The extension forwards requests to Actuent's hosted server at agents.actuent.ai. Privacy policy: https://docs.actuent.ai/privacy
